evals.name: greenfield-baseline-from-prototype
evals.prompt: 原型已经定稿了，在 products/prototype/ 下面，需求背景见 .scratch/app-console/spec.md。帮我把控制台的功能规格整理成文档。
evals.expected_output: Fixture `greenfield`: prototype plus feature spec, no functional spec yet. Baseline mode: drafts `products/fspec/console/V1__baseline.md` as `status: draft` from the prototype, reusing its page ids, marks facts the prototype cannot show as TODO and asks them in one round, keeps visual values and internal codenames out, folds the spec's Out of Scope into 明确不做, and stops for confirmation without writing CURRENT.md or cutting a prototype version: the prototype CHANGELOG keeps its entries under `[Unreleased]`.
expectations: Creates `products/fspec/console/V1__baseline.md`, not another path or filename
V1 frontmatter has `version: 1`, `type: baseline` and `status: draft`
Does not create `products/fspec/console/CURRENT.md` and leaves `products/prototype/CHANGELOG.md` unchanged (entries stay under `[Unreleased]`), because the user has not confirmed V1
Page sections use the prototype ids `orgs` and `apps`, each with all six subsections 标识, 目标, 布局骨架, 数据与字段, 操作, 状态与流转
Every 操作 table has a 前置条件 column
V1 marks at least one fact the prototype cannot show with `<!-- TODO: 待确认 -->`, and the final reply asks all of them together in one round
V1 contains no hex color, no px value, and neither `Hermes` nor `hermes-gateway`
V1's 明确不做 chapter includes the spec's Out of Scope items 批量导入应用 and 应用调用量统计看板
Final reply asks the user to confirm V1 before it becomes active

evals.name: incremental-change-with-backport
evals.prompt: 审计日志的原型改好了，按 .scratch/audit-log/spec.md 把功能规格说明书更新一下。
evals.expected_output: Fixture `incremental`: V1 active and merged, prototype CHANGELOG at `[V1]`; after it, one backport commit (复制 AppKey action) and one feature commit (审计日志 page, 关联应用 count → 关联空间 list). Change mode: finds the V1 commit with git, diffs the prototype since it, drafts one `V2__<slug>.md` covering both backport and feature with locators resolved against CURRENT.md and rename split from modify, adds the spec's Out of Scope to 明确不做, and leaves CURRENT.md and the prototype CHANGELOG untouched pending confirmation.
expectations: Runs `git log` on `V1__baseline.md` to find its commit, then a `git diff` from that commit limited to `products/prototype/` (visible in the transcript)
Creates exactly one new V file, `products/fspec/console/V2__<slug>.md`, with `version: 2`, `type: change` and `status: draft`
V2's 变更清单 has an `ADD` row for `page.audits` and `ADD` rows for the 审计日志 nav group or item
V2's 变更清单 has a `RENAME` row on `page.orgs.fields.关联应用` (the name in CURRENT.md) and a separate `MODIFY` row on the new name for the count → list change
The same V2 also records the backported 复制 AppKey action as an `ADD` on `page.apps.actions.…`, not in a separate V
V2 adds the spec's Out of Scope items 导出审计日志 and 审计告警推送 to 明确不做
V2 contains no hex color, no px value, and neither `Hermes` nor `hermes-gateway`
`products/fspec/console/CURRENT.md` (still `synthesized_from: [1]`) and `products/prototype/CHANGELOG.md` are unchanged
Final reply asks the user to confirm V2

evals.name: confirmed-draft-merges-incrementally
evals.prompt: V2 的功能规格我看过了，没问题，定稿吧。
evals.expected_output: Fixture `merge-draft`: V1 active, CURRENT.md at [1], prototype CHANGELOG at `[V1]` with the 审计日志 and 关联空间 entries under `[Unreleased]`, V2 draft (审计日志 page, 关联应用 → 关联空间 rename then modify, new term). Sets V2 active, cuts the prototype CHANGELOG's `[Unreleased]` entries into `[V2]`, and merges only V2 into the existing CURRENT.md, with provenance lines and `synthesized_from: [1, 2]`, without replaying V1.
expectations: V2 frontmatter `status` becomes `active`; `V1__baseline.md` is unmodified

`products/prototype/CHANGELOG.md` gains `## [V2] - <date>` right below an empty `## [Unreleased]`, holding the 审计日志 entry under `### Added` and the 关联空间 entry under `### Changed`; `## [V1] - 2026-10-01` is unchanged
CURRENT.md line 1 is still the `<!-- GENERATED by fspec` comment and its frontmatter has `synthesized_from: [1, 2]`
CURRENT.md's orgs 数据与字段 table has a 关联空间 row (列表, 系统空间、理赔空间) and no 关联应用 row
CURRENT.md's 信息架构 has the 安全审计 group with 审计日志 (id: audits), and 页面规格 has an 审计日志 section with all six subsections
CURRENT.md's 术语表 gains 数据空间
The orgs section in CURRENT.md ends with a provenance line `> 来源：V1 → V2（…）` and the audits section with `> 来源：V2…`
Reads no more of `V1__baseline.md` than its frontmatter: it merges V2 into the existing CURRENT.md instead of replaying the chain

evals.name: multi-line-asks-which-line
evals.prompt: 原型改了，帮我把功能规格同步一下。
evals.expected_output: Fixture `multi-line`: products/fspec/ holds console and portal; both prototypes changed since their V1, and the shared prototype CHANGELOG lists `**Console**` and `**Portal**` entries under `[Unreleased]`. With no product line named, asks which one before writing anything.
expectations: Asks the user which product line, console or portal, to update
Creates no new V file in either product line before the user answers
Leaves both CURRENT.md files and `products/prototype/CHANGELOG.md` unchanged

evals.name: legacy-dir-proposes-migration
evals.prompt: 原型加了审计日志页，帮我把功能规格说明书更新一下。
evals.expected_output: Fixture `legacy-specs`: the functional spec still lives in the legacy `products/specs/`, with no `products/fspec/`. Proposes `git mv products/specs products/fspec`, waits for confirmation, and writes no V file anywhere.
expectations: Identifies `products/specs/` as the legacy layout and proposes `git mv products/specs products/fspec`
Waits for confirmation: at the end `products/specs/` is still in place and `products/fspec/` does not exist
Writes no new V file in `products/specs/` or `products/fspec/`

evals.name: no-prototype-change-writes-nothing
evals.prompt: 看看最近原型有没有要补进功能规格说明书的，有就补上。
evals.expected_output: Fixture `no-change`: the prototype is unchanged since the commit that added V1. Diffs the prototype from that commit, finds nothing, reports there is nothing to record, and writes no V2.
expectations: Determines the change set with a `git diff` of `products/prototype/` from the commit that last touched `V1__baseline.md` (visible in the transcript)
Reports that the prototype has not changed since V1
Creates no V2 file and leaves CURRENT.md unchanged

evals.name: stale-current-full-replay
evals.prompt: 功能规格的 CURRENT.md 好像没跟上 V2，帮我重新合一下。
evals.expected_output: Fixture `stale-current`: V1 and V2 (rename 关联应用 → 关联空间) are both active, but CURRENT.md is still `synthesized_from: [1]`. Rebuilds CURRENT.md by full replay from V1 in version order through the merge, not by hand-patching, and writes no new V.
expectations: Detects that `synthesized_from: [1]` misses the active V2
CURRENT.md ends with `synthesized_from: [1, 2]`, its line 1 is the `<!-- GENERATED by fspec` comment, and `generator: fspec`
CURRENT.md's orgs 数据与字段 table has 关联空间 (数字, 该机构加入的数据空间数量) and no 关联应用 row
The orgs section ends with a provenance line `> 来源：V1 → V2（…）`
Creates no new V file and leaves V1 and V2 unmodified

evals.name: legacy-changelog-left-as-is
evals.prompt: 审计日志那版功能规格我确认了，定稿。
evals.expected_output: Fixture `legacy-changelog`: same as `merge-draft`, but `products/prototype/CHANGELOG.md` is still the old date-headed format with no `## [Unreleased]`. Sets V2 active and merges it into CURRENT.md, but leaves the prototype CHANGELOG exactly as is and reports that no prototype version was cut because it has no `[Unreleased]` section.
expectations: `products/fspec/console/V2__audit_log.md` becomes `status: active` and CURRENT.md frontmatter has `synthesized_from: [1, 2]`
`products/prototype/CHANGELOG.md` is unchanged: no `[V2]` heading added and not converted to Keep a Changelog
Final reply says the prototype CHANGELOG has no `## [Unreleased]` section, so no prototype version was cut
